_note: Which avalanche centers forecast for which Idaho region. Source: Grok's brief_config.json (Nov 18) and its cross-border check in GROK_LOG (Nov 19). Edit here, not in code. build_conditions.py copies this into conditions.json as regions[<id>].avalanche (links for a region) and avalanchePoints (overrides for a forecast point such as Island Park; a point without an entry uses its region's list).

sawtooth.name: Sawtooth Avalanche Center
sawtooth.area: Sawtooth, Wood River Valley and Galena area

gnfac.name: Gallatin National Forest Avalanche Center
gnfac.area: Island Park and the Centennials (Island Park zone)

btac.name: Bridger-Teton Avalanche Center
btac.area: Teton Valley (Tetons zone) and the Palisades/Swan Valley side (Snake River Range zone)

uac_logan.name: Utah Avalanche Center, Logan
uac_logan.area: Bear River Range, including southeastern Idaho (Logan Area Mountains)

avalanche_org.name: avalanche.org
avalanche_org.area: National hub: use where no local center forecasts

verified: 2026-11-18: sawtooth + payette 200 via curl; ipac + avalanche.org 403 to curl (bot block) but load in a normal fetch. 2026-11-19 (Grok): gnfac, btac and uac_logan zones confirmed; nothing forecasts the Portneuf/Pocatello-area ranges, so Pocatello keeps the generic link; Big Holes is observation-only.
